entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I bought some shoes, and I think I need to return them. I'm a little overwhelmed with the whole process. The website was... a lot.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number is VF78901. I just... I don't know if I can even return them. It's been a while.

Thank you, Sarah. I've pulled up your order for the Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm not sure what you mean. They just hurt my feet. I tried them a few times and got terrible blisters. And the metal things on the bottom... the cleats? I can't figure them out. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?

I understand your frustration with the blisters and the confusion about the cleats. That sounds very uncomfortable. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I review the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Thank you for your patience, Sarah. I've checked our policy. I see the order was delivered 55 days ago, and our standard return window is 10 days.
Oh! Ninety days? I thought it was much shorter. So... I can return them?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return process in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email address on file right now. Simply pack the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office.
Wow, that's... actually really easy. Thank you so much. I was so worried. So once you get them back, I get the full refund?

That's correct. Once our warehouse receives and processes the return, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. You'll receive an email notification at that time as well. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
